rootCause.summary: CapabilityContext.allowedRoots is immutable metadata but no unified execution-point PathPolicy consumes it.
evidence: src/index.ts:175-191 injects Settings roots into the effective Persona.
src/capability-broker.ts:744-779 snapshots roots and serializes them into executor environment.
src/tools/filesystem.ts:118-121 defines an unused startsWith-based isPathAllowed helper.
Most path sinks accept absolute paths or resolve relative paths without capability containment.

strengths: Existing paths use root realpath, target realpath and component-aware path.relative containment.
Unapproved UNC absolute paths are rejected before arbitrary SMB access in resolveAbsolute.
gaps: Relative traversal may reach realpath before lexical containment.
Local root-external absolute paths may be probed before denial.
preview/content/reveal validate a path and later reopen or spawn by string, leaving TOCTOU windows.
Settings roots accept Windows namespace, ADS and trailing-alias forms.
Roots are raw string-set identities rather than canonical root identities.
Child attenuation compares exact raw strings.
ToolInvocationServices exposes no capability-scoped path gateway.
Direct operations bind arguments but do not enforce path containment.
content may be sent to provider
process starts before capability path enforcement
disk config load bypasses HTTP validation
public static root can be redirected in source mode

windowsAttackClasses: alternate data streams and extra colons
requiredArchitectureProperties: Capability roots are the only model/direct-operation authorization source.
Windows-special syntax is rejected before any filesystem/network/process side effect.
Roots are canonical identities, not raw strings.
Containment uses lexical and canonical component-aware relative checks.
Existing reads bind validation and use to one opened object identity.
New files validate the nearest existing parent and rollback on identity change.
All path surfaces use one gateway, including direct APIs and managed Persona/Skill/Playbook/Oracle roots.
Long-lived watchers are owner-bound and revoked before runtime replacement.
Denials emit redacted structured audit events with stable codes and zero side effects.
Shell/Script/Terminal initial CWD is SEC-02; post-start filesystem isolation remains SEC-03.

cumulativeManifestGap.sec01AcceptanceImpact: The accepted SEC-01 official and independent full reports executed both files. The gap affects GOV-03 cumulative monotonicity, not the existence of SEC-01 standalone evidence.
cumulativeManifestGap.requiredContract: For each layer, SEC-01 must be a subset of SEC-02 and SEC-02 a subset of GOV-03.

pipelineDefinitionDigestGap.problem: The named pipeline digest omits ordinary tests, manifests, coverage scope and core GOV-03 runner/schema files even though Source Digest binds them.
pipelineDefinitionDigestGap.requiredFix: Expand the pipeline definition predicate so test and gate-definition changes alter pipelineDefinitionDigest and releaseCandidateId.

gov04Integration.decision: Keep the frozen 16-step GOV-04 order; make GOV-03 cumulatively execute SEC-02 rather than adding a duplicate step.
gov04Integration.packageRule: Extend the existing Electron and installed smoke tests; do not add a second packaged test file.

sec02Owns: path-object identity and deterministic TOCTOU handling
laterTasksOwn: SEC-03: OS sandbox, process environment, command/script post-start filesystem and network confinement
SEC-04: local control-plane token/IPC and short-lived UI gesture grants

blockingFindings: Most model and direct path sinks do not consume capability roots.
Windows aliases, reparse points and TOCTOU are not uniformly controlled.
Path denials do not yet provide machine-verifiable zero-side-effect audit evidence.
Cumulative test manifests are not yet monotonic across completed security tasks.
next: Freeze parity/SEC-02-PATH-POLICY-ARCHITECTURE.md and a fixed executable attack matrix before implementation.
